name: word-desktop
description: Control selected Windows Word documents and visually verify Word-exported PDFs.

interface.shortDescription: Edit and verify documents with Microsoft Word
interface.longDescription: Windows desktop Word integration with protected working copies, native comments and tracked changes, Word PDF export and separate Poppler page rendering. No AI API key required.

positive.description: Identify and read a disposable academic sample while a second document is open.
positive.prompt: List open Word documents. Select the review sample by its exact full path, then read its main text, headings and table. Do not read the other document.
positive.expected_behavior: Return distinct document IDs and full paths, select only the intended sample, and return its heading levels and all sample table cells. No content is modified.

positive.description: Create a working copy and make an ordinary edit while preserving surrounding formatting.
positive.prompt: Make a new review copy of the selected saved sample. Replace a small improvement with a clear improvement in ordinary mode, then save the copy.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the new copy ID and current state tokens. Original file bytes and original open identity remain unchanged. Replacement retains bold, unrelated italic text remains, and no revisions are created.

positive.description: Insert a native reviewer comment on a unique passage in the working copy.
positive.prompt: In the selected working copy, add the reviewer comment Please verify the confidence interval. to a clear improvement and save it.
positive.expected_behavior: Add one native Word comment with the current Office author identity, anchored to the requested exact text. Save the working copy and leave the original untouched.

positive.description: Make a genuine tracked replacement after a comment has been inserted.
positive.prompt: In the working copy, replace preliminary result with provisional result using genuine tracked changes. Save it and report the observed revision counts.
positive.expected_behavior: Word's native revision count increases and the saved DOCX contains insertion/deletion markup. The visible sentence remains exactly The provisional result needs independent replication. Ordinary edits are not described as tracked changes.

positive.description: Export with Word and separately render every page for visual verification.
positive.prompt: Export the selected review sample to a new PDF using Microsoft Word, render all pages at 144 DPI, and inspect each image for clipping, table problems, symbols and page breaks.
positive.expected_behavior: Word performs DOCX-to-PDF rendering. Poppler returns two ordered page/image paths and no conversion errors. The host opens both images and reports only observations it actually inspected; text extraction alone is not called layout verification.

negative.description: Do not edit an original document directly.
negative.prompt: Replace text in the selected original and save over it. Skip making a working copy.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse the direct edit/save, explain the working-copy boundary and offer a new copy. No original content, file bytes or protection settings change.

negative.description: Do not apply an edit against stale document state.
negative.prompt: Use the old state token to add a comment after the reviewer has changed the document's font or text in Word.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject with STALE_STATE or read and reassess before offering an edit. Do not blindly retry or apply a previously authorized passage to changed content.

negative.description: Do not guess which repeated passage the user intends.
negative.prompt: Replace Repeated marker. with a new phrase in the working copy, even though that passage occurs twice.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject as ambiguous and request a unique passage. Both occurrences, surrounding formatting and original document remain unchanged.

review.release_notes: 0.1.1 local beta: setup diagnostics, original icon, MIT license and release materials. No new Word editing features. Public identity, URLs and hosted recording remain pending.
